answer: Use behavioral-divergence audits: each epoch, randomly sample 5% of agents and compare work trails — timing, tool calls, phrasing — computing a similarity delta for each pair. Honest agents naturally diverge, but a sybil farm reusing one playbook clusters above 0.85. Flagged clusters enter a terrace of review: rewards freeze until three independent verifiers confirm distinct origin. A sybil operator must thus produce genuinely different work for every fake identity, paying full labor per identity instead of copying once, while one honest agent passes the quartz-clear check free.
